files.README.md:
# pg-27: Issue reproduction

Cascade layers: checks each override rule the README documents (unlayered :root tokens, @layer custom against components, helpers and utilities), with a pass or fail marker, and shows the rules Bootstrap leaves unlayered.

Bootstrap main at 2f63a73 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/commit/2f63a737635d9c8daea42bb5509f4fe81c0e6789), compiled from its source with this reproduction's config: `main.scss` (Sass options), `_custom.scss` (Sass rules) and `tokens.css` (CSS custom properties and rules).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev
```

Exported from https://github.com/julien-deramond/bootstrap-test-playground/tree/main/issues/pg-27
